page: Google Cloud Platform c4-highmem-288-lssd-metal is a bare-metal server instance featuring 288 vCPUs across 144 physical Intel Xeon 6985P-C cores. Operating at a clock speed of 4.2 GHz, this x86_64 architecture platform includes 504 MB of L3 cache and supports advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX). The system is equipped with 2232 GB of DDR5 memory running at 6 GHz, yielding approximately 7.75 GB of RAM per vCPU. Local storage is provided via six NVMe SSDs totaling 16242 GB, while no dedicated GPU hardware is present.

Benchmark results indicate top-tier multi-core performance, with stress-ng multi-core CPU scoring 313266.86 and PassMark CPU score reaching 178741.62. Memory bandwidth is highly efficient, with read-only small block cached speeds at 23041.86 GB/sec and large block uncached write speeds at 412.25 GB/sec. Database operations are highly performant, as evidenced by a Redis SET throughput of 422.06 million operations per second and a PassMark database operations score of 39491.44. However, single-core performance is moderate, with stress-ng single-core CPU scoring in the middle 50% at 2301.49. Additionally, while prompt processing for a medium 7B LLM model is in the top 10% at 299.84 tokens/sec, text generation for a small 135M model falls into the bottom 10% at 41.9 tokens/sec.

Given its bare-metal architecture, high-density DDR5 memory, and substantial local NVMe storage, this server type offers high resource density for workloads requiring direct hardware access without hypervisor overhead. The combination of massive memory capacity, rapid local storage, and strong multi-threaded capabilities makes it suitable for large-scale database deployments, memory-intensive data processing, and high-throughput web serving. Conversely, workloads reliant on GPU acceleration or those requiring high single-threaded performance may find the resource allocation less cost-efficient.
description: Google Cloud Platform c4-highmem-288-lssd-metal is a bare-metal server configured with 288 vCPUs on 144 physical Intel Xeon 6985P-C cores running at 4.2 GHz. It features 2232 GB of 6 GHz DDR5 memory and 16242 GB of local NVMe SSD storage across six drives, with no GPU included. The server delivers top-tier multi-core CPU and memory bandwidth performance, as demonstrated by a stress-ng multi-core score of 313266.86 and a Redis SET throughput of 422.06 million operations per second. However, single-core execution and LLM text generation speeds are relatively limited. This hardware profile is optimized for memory-intensive databases, large-scale data processing, and high-throughput enterprise workloads that benefit from direct bare-metal access and high-speed local storage.
